ART 11.name: First Year Seminar--School of Visual Arts
ART 11.description: Introductory seminar for first-year students in the School of Visual Arts.

ART 110.name: Ideas as Visual Images
ART 110.description: Introductory studio course exploring visual thinking and image-making.

ART 111.name: Ideas as Objects
ART 111.description: Introductory studio course exploring three-dimensional and object-based thinking.

ART 122Y.name: Commentary on Art
ART 122Y.description: Writing-intensive course on art criticism and commentary.

ART 211Y.name: Introduction to Digital Art and Design Criticism
ART 211Y.description: Introduction to the language, aesthetics, and cultural impacts of digital art and design in contemporary society.

ART 476.name: History and Theory of Digital Art
ART 476.description: Examines digital art through a humanistic lens, covering how technology has transformed artistic practices. Bulletin requires '3 credits of ARTH' at enrollment -- approximated as any one of the ARTH courses already in the catalog rather than the literal free-standing credit count, since the schema doesn't support 'any N credits from a department' prereqs. Real gap: the Digital Arts and Media Design B.Des. plan itself never otherwise schedules an ARTH course, so ARTH 111 was added as an explicit Semester 1 item to satisfy this.
